$comment: Library of ready-made enemies for adventure authors. Original content only. Numbers follow rules/gm-guide.md §2.2 by level band; tags are for search. Change both together (see CLAUDE.md).

enemies.name: Ash Rat Swarm
traits: Each rat that drops lowers the swarm's damage by 1.

enemies.name: Cave Spider Swarm
traits: Venom. A hit also gives the target a Bane on Might Tests until the end of the scene.

enemies.name: Bone Pilgrim
traits: Undead. Immune to fear and poison.
Hollow. Takes double damage from Shatter and other thunder effects.

enemies.name: Cinder Goblin
traits: Skulk. Gains Hidden when in darkness.
dread: (1) Fire Pot. Throws a pot at a zone. Every hero there dodges vs DC 12 or starts Burning.

enemies.name: Hollow Sentry
traits: Immune to poison and fear. Takes double damage from Shatter and other thunder effects.

enemies.name: Reach Wolf
traits: Pack. +2 damage if another wolf is next to the target.
dread: (1) Drag Down. A hit knocks the target prone.

enemies.name: Smoke Wraith
traits: Takes half damage from non-magic weapons.
dread: (1) Dread Wail. Every hero in Near range rolls Will vs Will DC 12 or becomes Frightened.

enemies.name: Bandit Cutthroat
traits: Dirty Fighter. +1 damage against a hero who has a Bane.
dread: (1) Dust in the Eyes. A hero in reach dodges vs DC 12 or takes a Bane on their next Test.

enemies.name: Bandit Archer
traits: Volley. Attacks at Far range without a Bane.
dread: (1) Pin Down. A hit means the target cannot move on their next turn.

enemies.name: Slag Hound
traits: Hot Hide. A hero who hits it in melee takes 1 fire damage.
Immune to fire.
dread: (1) Ember Bark. Every hero in Near range dodges vs DC 12 or starts Burning.

enemies.name: Tomb Shambler
traits: Slow. Acts last in the Foes' Phase.
Undead. Immune to fear and poison.

enemies.name: Bandit Captain
traits: Commander. Allied bandits get +1 damage.
dread: (2) Parry. Cancel one hit against the captain.

enemies.name: Ember Drake
traits: Immune to fire.
dread: (2) Flame Breath. Line attack. Dodge vs DC 14 or take 12 fire damage (half on a success at a cost).

enemies.name: The Soot King
traits: Boss turns. After each hero's turn, the Soot King makes one attack or moves.
Ash Crown. Below 35 Grit, the room fills with smoke. Everyone without darkvision is Blinded beyond Reach.
dread: (1) Summon Soot. Call 3 Ash Rats.
(2) Smother. Grab a hero (escape DC 13). That hero takes 6 damage at the start of each round.

enemies.name: Glass Wasp Swarm
traits: Brittle. Each wasp that drops lowers the swarm's damage by 1.
Sting. A hit also gives the target a Bane on Grace Tests until the end of their next turn.

enemies.name: Ashen Knight
traits: Cinder Plate. Reduce the first hit against it each round by 2.
dread: (1) Shield Bash. The target knocks prone unless they dodge vs DC 13.

enemies.name: Bog Lurker
traits: Ambush. It is Hidden while submerged. Its first attack from hiding adds +2 to its Attack DC.
dread: (1) Drag Under. Grab a hero (escape DC 13). A held hero takes 3 damage at the start of each round.

enemies.name: Veil Witch
traits: Veil. Attacks against her from beyond Reach take a Bane.
dread: (1) Hex Knot. One hero rolls Will vs Will DC 13 or takes a Bane on all Tests until the end of the witch's next turn.

enemies.name: Mirror Stalker
traits: Reflection. When a hero misses it by 5 or more, the hero takes 2 damage.
dread: (1) Borrowed Face. It looks like one hero until it attacks or is hit.

enemies.name: Chain Warden
traits: Reach. Its chains hit targets up to 2 zones away.
Constructed. Immune to poison.
dread: (2) Haul In. Pull a hero next to it. That hero takes a Bane on their next Test.

enemies.name: The Hollow Queen
traits: Boss turns. After each hero's turn, the Hollow Queen makes one attack or moves.
Drowned Court. Below 30 Grit, the room floods knee-deep. Moving costs double.
dread: (1) Call the Bell. Every hero rolls Will vs Will DC 14 or loses their next Action.
(2) Raise the Drowned. Summon 4 Bone Pilgrims.

enemies.name: Quarry Brute
traits: Thick Skin. Reduce all damage against it by 1.
dread: (1) Rockfall. Every hero in a zone dodges vs DC 14 or takes 6 damage.

enemies.name: Storm Harrier
traits: Stormcharged. A hero who hits it with a metal weapon takes 2 lightning damage.
dread: (1) Thunderclap. Every hero in Near range dodges vs DC 14 or is Deafened until the end of the scene.

enemies.name: Greywood Stalker
traits: Bark Hide. Takes double damage from fire.
Rooted. Cannot be pushed or knocked prone.
dread: (2) Grasping Roots. Every hero in a zone is Held (escape DC 14).

enemies.name: Gloom Priest
traits: Shroud. Allies in Near range get +1 to their Defense.
dread: (2) Dread Litany. Every hero rolls Will vs Will DC 14 or becomes Frightened.
(1) Shadow Ward. Cancel one hit against an ally.

enemies.name: Deep Rail Crawler
traits: Burrower. It can come up under any zone in the scene.
dread: (1) Tunnel Strike. It surfaces next to a hero and attacks with +2 damage.

enemies.name: Rift Wisp Swarm
traits: Flicker. The swarm ignores terrain and cover.

enemies.name: Pale Reaver
traits: Undead. Immune to fear and poison.
Relentless. When it drops, roll d6: on a 6 it stands with 1 Grit.
dread: (1) Cleave. A second hero next to the target takes half the damage.

enemies.name: Hollow Duelist
traits: Fast. It can move before and after its attacks.
dread: (1) Riposte. When a hero misses it by 5 or more, it attacks that hero at once.
(2) Disarm. A hero drops their weapon unless they dodge vs DC 15.

enemies.name: Furnace Colossus
traits: Immune to fire.
Molten Core. Below 20 Grit, everyone in Reach takes 3 fire damage each round.
dread: (2) Vent. Every hero in Near range dodges vs DC 15 or takes 12 fire damage (half on a success at a cost).

enemies.name: Tidecaller
traits: Sea-born. Gets a Boon on Tests in water.
Immune to cold.
dread: (2) Rising Tide. The scene floods: all heroes dodge vs DC 15 or are Knocked prone and swept one zone.
(1) Undertow. A hero is pulled one zone toward the Tidecaller.

enemies.name: Cinder Wyrm
traits: Immune to fire.
Hot Scales. A hero who hits it in melee takes 3 fire damage.
dread: (2) Cinder Breath. Cone attack. Dodge vs DC 16 or take 16 fire damage and start Burning (half and no Burning on a success at a cost).

enemies.name: Voidglass Seer
traits: Foresight. It gets a Boon on dodge Tests it makes against Attack DCs of 16 or less.
dread: (2) Shatter Mind. Every hero rolls Will vs Will DC 16 or loses their next Action.
(1) Reflect. Send a spell back at its caster.

enemies.name: The Ash Sovereign
traits: Boss turns. After each hero's turn, the Ash Sovereign makes one attack or moves.
Phases. At 60 and 30 Grit the throne room changes: first falling embers (2 damage a round in Reach), then darkness (all Tests Bane beyond Reach).
dread: (1) Call the Court. Summon 4 Pale Reavers.
(2) Final Ember. Every hero dodges vs DC 16 or takes 14 fire damage (half on a success at a cost).

enemies.name: Throne Revenant
traits: Boss turns. After each hero's turn, the Revenant makes one attack or moves.
Undying. At 0 Grit it rises once with 30 Grit, unless a hero spends an Action on the Ember Seal (Spirit Test DC 16).
dread: (1) Command. One hero rolls Will vs Will DC 16 or attacks an ally.
(2) Grave Chill. Every hero takes 8 cold damage and a Bane on Grace Tests until the end of the scene.
